label: Scientific calculator
empty: Create a calculation and link it to the work it supports.
name: Name
copyFailed: Could not copy the result. Select the result text to copy it.
emptyResult: Enter a value or choose a function.
timeout: Calculation exceeded the time limit. Simplify the expression.
engineError: The calculation engine could not load.
incomplete: Complete the function or bracket before calculating.
limit: Use up to 100 expressions, 2,000 characters each and 20,000 characters per worksheet.
precisionInfo: Decimal arithmetic uses 64 significant digits. Results show up to 32 significant digits. Reusing a calculation keeps its expression and computes it again. Integer base conversion is exact.
valuesHint: Separate numbers with spaces, commas or new lines.
legacyEngine: This saved revision uses the original decimal calculation engine.
approximateInfo: Approximate result: 64 significant digits during calculation, up to 32 displayed.
exactPrecisionInfo: Integer and rational arithmetic is exact, including dependent spreadsheet formulas. Recurring fractions remain ratios. Unit conversions and non-rational functions use 64-digit decimal arithmetic and are marked approximate; up to 32 digits are displayed. Calculations that exceed the resource budget stop without rounding an exact value.
fixedPolicyEngine: This saved revision uses the fixed exact/64-digit engine.
policyMeaning: Exact rational results are not rounded. These limits stop exhausted calculations; they never replace an exact result with an approximation. The explicit round() function retains its own rounding rule.
policyEngine: Engine 3, mathjs {version}. Working digits: 16-256; displayed digits: 1 to working digits. Exact bits: 64-65,536; arithmetic operations: 1-50,000; time: 1-5,000 ms per evaluation request.
invalidPolicy: Enter values within the declared limits; displayed digits cannot exceed working digits.
policyApproximation: Approximate result: {working} working digits, up to {display} displayed; {rounding}.
policyLegacyError: This historical engine cannot use configurable precision. Choose Use configurable precision to create a new revision.
policyLibraryError: The library version retained by this calculation is unavailable. Its saved expression and policy remain unchanged.
policyRealError: No finite real scalar result is available. Complex-valued operations are not supported.
upgradeStructuredEngine: Use exact vectors, matrices and complex values
scalarPolicyEngine: This saved revision uses the configurable scalar engine. Upgrading keeps its precision and resource settings.
structuredHelp: Engine 4 evaluates numerical vectors, matrices and complex expressions exactly. Ordinary scalar functions and unit conversions retain the saved approximation policy. A structured expression with a non-exact component is refused; no field, unit or coordinate meaning is inferred.
structuredValuesHint: Separate vector entries with commas. For a matrix, enter one comma-separated row per line. Keep complete exact expressions, for example 1/3, 2. Rows must have matching lengths.
invalidStructuredValues: Enter vector entries on one line or non-empty matrix rows. The complete expression must fit the worksheet limits; nothing was inserted.
imaginaryRoot: Add square root of minus one
structuredOperations: Syntax: [1/3, 2], [[1, 2], [3, 4]], i, sqrt(-1), dot([1, 2], [3, 4]) and matmul([[1, 2]], [[3], [4]]). Shapes must match the selected operation. Structured results have no approximate fallback.
structuredPolicyEngine: Engine 4, mathjs {version}, exact structured engine 1. The saved policy also limits structured components and complete result characters. Exceeding a limit refuses the calculation without truncating its result.
structuredShapeError: The exact vector or matrix shapes do not match this operation. Check vector lengths, row lengths and matrix product dimensions.
structuredUnsupportedError: This structured expression has no supported exact interpretation. Keep all components exact and use the supported vector, matrix or complex operations.
structuredResourceError: The complete exact structured calculation exceeds its saved limits. Review the component, result-character and arithmetic limits; the input is unchanged.
structuredZeroDivisorError: Exact structured division by zero is not defined. Check the scalar or complex divisor.
retainExactOnly: Retain a complete exact result or a supported finite real approximation from engine 4. Save the calculation first.
mathErrorExpressionLength: Use an expression of at most 2,000 characters.
mathErrorSupported: Only numbers, units, functions and arithmetic are supported.
mathErrorConstantDigits: Use numeric constants of at most 100 digits.
mathErrorExactDisplay: The exact result exceeds the display resource budget.
mathErrorScalar: The expression must produce a scalar number or quantity.
mathErrorFinite: The expression has no finite result.
mathErrorDisplaySize: The result is too large to display.
mathErrorIntegerBases: Enter an integer and bases from 2 to 36.
mathErrorNumberBases: Enter a number or ratio and bases from 2 to 36.
mathErrorBaseDigits: Enter digits, a fraction or a ratio in the selected base.
mathErrorDigitBase: Digit {digit} is not valid in base {base}
mathErrorRange: Ranges must contain at most 200 cells in forward order.
mathErrorZero: Division by zero has no finite result.
mathErrorInputBudget: Exact input exceeds the calculation resource budget.
mathErrorValueBudget: Exact value exceeds the calculation resource budget.
mathErrorArithmeticBudget: Exact arithmetic exceeded the calculation resource budget.
mathErrorResultBudget: Exact result exceeds the calculation resource budget.
mathErrorIntermediateBudget: Exact intermediate exceeds the calculation resource budget.
mathErrorPowerBudget: Exact power exceeds the calculation resource budget.
mathErrorRounding: Rounding precision must be an integer.
mathErrorWorksheet: Use up to 100 expressions in one worksheet.
mathErrorUnitValue: Cannot convert to a unit with a value
mathErrorUnitComparison: Cannot compare units with different base
mathErrorAngle: This trigonometric function requires an angle unit.
mathErrorTooFewArguments: Too few arguments for {name}; expected {expected} at position {position}.
mathErrorTooManyArguments: Too many arguments for {name}; expected {expected}, received {actual}.
mathErrorSyntaxAssignment: Invalid left hand side of assignment operator =
mathErrorSyntaxFalse: False part of conditional expression expected
mathErrorSyntaxTrue: The true-expression of a conditional operator may not be empty
mathErrorSyntaxObjectKey: Symbol or string expected as object key
mathErrorSyntaxObjectEnd: Comma , or bracket } expected after object value
